title: The scaffold gives people and AI a shared workspace

elements.text:
npm create apiops@latest payments
cd payments
npm run method:start
npm run method:canvases:new-api
Choose API Productization and REST in the prompts. The tooling requires Node.js 22 or later.
The starter includes a sample Catalog contract; your team builds the payment runtime in its chosen language.

notes:
APIOps introduction. Technical continuation is illustrative; no client implementation or measured improvement is claimed.

Source-reviewed local versions: apiops-cycles-method-data 4.2.1 and create-apiops 1.1.4. The npm initializer command is documented by the local package. An isolated project was generated with the local initializer, API Productization, REST, English and --no-install. That mode skips installation and canvas generation. The command block shows the normal installed workflow. The scaffold supplies a design and review workspace, not a complete payment implementation.
